promise.id: Pahami budaya Bali melalui kegiatan membuat, ritual, dan ruang lokal; bukan sekadar melihat tempat wisata.

pois.name: Tirta Empul
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms the Tampaksiring water-temple context and sarong requirement. Melukat participation, ceremony access, opening hours and fees still require a live check.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: A Guide to the Holy Springs of Tirta Empul

pois.name: The Yoga Barn
pois.notes: The official venue confirms The Yoga Barn as an Ubud yoga and wellness centre offering classes and events. This verifies the venue and activity categories only; recheck the live schedule, price, availability, teacher, waiver, accessibility and suitability, and never present wellness marketing as medical treatment or a guaranteed outcome.

pois.name: Pyramids of Chi
pois.notes: The official venue confirms Pyramids of Chi in the Ubud area as a purpose-built sound and wellness events venue. This verifies identity, location context and activity categories only; recheck the live event calendar, price, availability, practitioner, contraindications, waiver, transport and refund terms, and do not convert spiritual or wellness claims into medical advice.

pois.name: Heart Space Bali
pois.notes: Heart Space Bali's official pages confirm an Ubud venue offering yoga, sound-based and wellness classes. This verifies the venue identity and service category only; it does not verify medical benefit or therapeutic outcomes. Recheck the live schedule, facilitator, availability, suitability, price, cancellation terms and booking path before recommending a class.

pois.name: Intuitive Flow
pois.notes: Intuitive Flow's official pages confirm a yoga studio in the Penestanan area of Ubud with yoga and meditation class categories. The Ubud node is an itinerary grouping, not a precise administrative-address claim. This does not verify medical benefit or self-healing outcomes. Recheck the live schedule, teacher, availability, suitability, price, payment, cancellation terms and booking path before recommending a class.

pois.name: Pura Luhur Uluwatu
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms the Pecatu clifftop temple context, Kecak association, modest clothing guidance and loose-item risk around macaques. Entry, performance schedule, prices, weather and traffic still require a live check.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Pura Luhur Uluwatu

pois.name: Pura Tanah Lot
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms the offshore temple in Beraban, Tabanan and visitor facilities. The Canggu node remains a routing convenience; tides, ceremony access, hours and drive time require a live check.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Tanah Lot

pois.name: Pura Ulun Danu Beratan
pois.notes: National and Tabanan tourism sources confirm Pura Ulun Danu Beratan as a Lake Beratan temple complex in Candikuning, Baturiti, Tabanan, with a highland and water-temple context. The G5/Bedugul node is an itinerary grouping, not an administrative-location claim. Recheck opening hours, ticket price, dress guidance, ceremony access, photography rules, weather, lake conditions, traffic and temporary closures before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Ulun Danu Beratan: iconic temple on Lake Beratan

pois.name: Pura Besakih
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms the temple complex in Besakih Village on Mount Agung's southwest slope and road access by car or motorbike. Dress, guide rules, hours, fees, ceremonies and current mountain-road conditions still require a live check.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Visiting Pura Besakih, the Largest Hindu Temple in Bali

pois.name: Garuda Wisnu Kencana Cultural Park
pois.notes: The venue and government tourism pages confirm GWK as a modern cultural park in the Jimbaran/Ungasan area, not a temple. Current admission, performance schedule and event closures require a live check on the official ticket page.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Taman Budaya GWK

pois.name: Batu Bolong Beach
pois.notes: National tourism guidance confirms Batu Bolong Beach in Canggu as a west-coast beach associated with surf, sunsets and nearby cafes. Recheck weather, tide, surf and swimming conditions, lifeguard coverage, access and traffic before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Batu Bolong Beach

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Pantai Canggu tourism registry

pois.name: Echo Beach
pois.notes: National tourism guidance confirms Echo Beach in Canggu as a beach known for surf, sunsets and beachside cafes. The North Kuta government page records Pantai Pura Batu Mejan / Echo Beach as the same Canggu coast. Recheck weather, tide, surf and swimming conditions, access, facilities and traffic before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Echo Beach Canggu
Tourism history and beaches of North Kuta

pois.name: Seminyak Beach
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms Seminyak as a west-coast beach and lifestyle district with surf and sunset appeal, and warns that road traffic can be congested. Recheck weather, surf, swimming conditions and journey time.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Seminyak

pois.name: Pura Petitenget
pois.notes: Badung tourism and Bali religious-affairs sources confirm Pura Petitenget near Petitenget Beach in Kerobokan Kelod, North Kuta, as an active Hindu temple with regional cultural significance. Recheck ceremony access, visitor permission, dress rules, opening hours, any contribution or fee, photography rules and traffic before travel.

sources.title: Petitenget Beach, Badung Perfect Destination for Nature and Culture Tourism

sources.publisher: Bali Provincial Office of the Ministry of Religious Affairs
sources.title: Pura Petitenget

pois.name: Padang Padang Beach
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms Padang Padang as a cliff-framed beach reached by stairs through a narrow rock passage and known for surfing. Recheck tide, surf and swimming conditions, stair access, crowding and any entry fee before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Padang Padang Beach

pois.name: Melasti Beach
pois.notes: The Badung tourism system and venue page confirm Melasti Beach in Ungasan, its limestone-cliff road access, visitor facilities and continuing ceremonial role. Recheck entry fees, ceremonies, event access, tide and swimming conditions.

sources.title: Melasti Beach, the Jewel of Uluwatu

pois.name: Pandawa Beach
pois.notes: Badung's official tourism system confirms Pandawa Beach in Kutuh Village behind limestone cliffs, its vehicle access and core visitor facilities. Recheck ticket and parking fees, traffic, weather, sea conditions, activity providers and temporary restrictions before travel.

pois.name: Bingin Beach
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms Bingin as part of the Uluwatu surf coast, while Badung government sources confirm the beach community and an active area-planning process. Recheck construction or access changes, stairs, surf and swimming conditions, weather and local facilities before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Surfing Uluwatu

sources.publisher: Badung Regency Public Works and Spatial Planning Office
sources.title: Bingin Beach area planning consultation

pois.name: Jimbaran Bay
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms the approximately four-kilometre Jimbaran Bay coast, fishing-village context and beachfront dining concentration. Choose a specific restaurant only after checking reviews, reservations, food needs, weather and pickup traffic.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Jimbaran Beach

pois.name: Nusa Dua Beach
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms Nusa Dua as a managed south-Bali seafront resort area with beach, accommodation and cultural facilities. Recheck access to the specific beach section, tide, swimming conditions, weather, events and traffic before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: A memorable experience in Nusa Dua

pois.name: Sanur Beach
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms Sanur east of Denpasar, its sunrise orientation, beachfront path, road access and public facilities. Tide, swimming, water activities, parking charges and boat-transfer timing still require a live check.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Sanur Beach

pois.name: Mertasari Beach
pois.notes: Denpasar City sources confirm Mertasari Beach in the Sanur coast, road access and public visitor facilities. Recheck weather, tide, swimming conditions, parking or shuttle arrangements and temporary activity restrictions before travel.

pois.name: Suluban Beach (Blue Point)
pois.notes: Badung's tourism system and national tourism guidance confirm Suluban Beach, also known as Blue Point Beach, in Pecatu, with narrow cliff access and strong surf. Recheck tide, surf and swimming conditions, stairs, weather, crowding, parking and entry arrangements before travel.

sources.title: Suluban Beach, also known as Blue Point Beach

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Suluban Beach

pois.name: Kelingking Beach Viewpoint
pois.notes: Klungkung government sources confirm Kelingking Beach in the western Nusa Penida visitor cluster. Recheck fast-boat operation, road conditions, cliff barriers, descent access, weather, heat and crowding; the viewpoint must not imply that the steep beach descent is suitable for every traveller.

sources.title: Regional spatial plan for Nusa Penida visitor areas

pois.name: Broken Beach (Pasih Uug)
pois.notes: Klungkung government sources identify Broken Beach / Pasih Uug in the western Nusa Penida visitor area. Recheck fast boats, road access, cliff barriers, weather, heat and crowding before travel.

sources.title: Regional spatial plan for Nusa Penida visitor areas

pois.name: Angel's Billabong
pois.notes: Klungkung government sources identify Angel's Billabong in the western Nusa Penida visitor area. Treat it as a coastal viewpoint unless a live safety check explicitly permits water access; recheck swell, tide, barriers, road conditions, weather and local restrictions.

sources.title: Regional spatial plan for Nusa Penida visitor areas

pois.name: Crystal Bay
pois.notes: Klungkung government sources confirm Crystal Bay in Sakti, Nusa Penida. Beach or snorkelling use still requires live checks for fast boats, sea state, currents, weather, operator credentials, equipment and traveller swimming ability.

sources.title: Regional spatial plan for Nusa Penida visitor areas

pois.name: Diamond Beach
pois.notes: Klungkung government sources identify Diamond Beach in Pejukutan, eastern Nusa Penida. Recheck fast boats, road conditions, cliff and stair access, tide, sea state, weather, heat and crowding before travel.

pois.name: Rumah Pohon Molenteng
pois.notes: Klungkung government sources identify the Rumah Pohon attraction in Pejukutan, eastern Nusa Penida. Recheck the exact access arrangement, stairs, queue, structural or photo-access rules, weather, heat and road conditions before travel.

sources.title: Regional spatial plan for Nusa Penida visitor areas

pois.name: Thousand Islands Viewpoint
pois.notes: Dicky's field itinerary names this east-coast viewpoint, but the exact public identity and its relationship to the government-listed sunrise hill near Rumah Pohon still require confirmation. Do not merge it with Rumah Pohon or present it as execution-ready until coordinates, access and local naming are checked.

pois.name: Atuh Beach
pois.notes: Klungkung government sources identify Atuh Beach in Pejukutan and include it in the northern Nusa Penida visitor area. Recheck fast boats, road and stair access, tide, sea conditions, weather, heat and crowding before travel.

sources.title: Regional spatial plan for Nusa Penida visitor areas

pois.name: Bali Fire Shooting Club
pois.notes: Supplier-dependent live-fire activity from Dicky's field itinerary. Do not recommend as execution-ready until the exact operator, legal and licensing status, certified trainer, age and health restrictions, safety briefing, protective equipment, insurance, firearm package, transport, cancellation policy and final price are confirmed for the traveller.

pois.name: Tegalalang Rice Terrace
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms the Tegallalang terraced-rice landscape in Gianyar north of central Ubud and its relationship to Bali's traditional subak irrigation. Recheck access, trail condition, weather, crowding, fees and any activity provider before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Tegallalang Rice Terraces

pois.name: Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary
pois.notes: The official sanctuary page confirms the Padangtegal address, semi-wild macaque setting, visitor map and safety guidance. Recheck current opening hours, admission price and temporary closures before travel.

pois.name: Ubud Palace
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms Ubud Palace, also known as Puri Saren Agung, in central Ubud, its royal and Balinese architectural context and partially public areas. Recheck public access, ceremonies, performance schedules, tickets and temporary closures before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Ubud Palace

pois.name: Ubud Art Market
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms Ubud Traditional Market as a changing local market for daily essentials and Balinese souvenirs. Recheck opening hours, vendor availability, prices, payment methods and any temporary access changes before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Ubud Traditional Market

pois.name: Celuk Village
pois.notes: National and Gianyar government sources confirm Celuk in Gianyar as a centre of Balinese silver craftsmanship. Visiting a village or gallery does not automatically verify a paid class or product quality; recheck the specific venue, opening hours, materials, pricing, accessibility and transport before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Balinese silver craft in local culture

pois.name: Celuk Bali Silver Class
pois.notes: Named hands-on supplier candidate supporting R4's craft promise. Do not present it as execution-ready until availability, instructor and workshop identity, material quantity and quality, child or accessibility needs, safety, current package inclusions, cancellation policy, transport and final price are confirmed directly.

pois.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms Campuhan Ridge Walk in the Ubud area as an accessible green-ridge walking route suited to a relaxed morning walk. Recheck weather, heat, trail surface, lighting, temporary restrictions and traveller mobility needs before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Campuhan Ridge Walk

pois.name: Goa Gajah
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms Goa Gajah in Bedulu, Gianyar as an archaeological and sacred complex with rock-cut cave, bathing structures and Hindu-Buddhist context. Recheck opening hours, fees, dress guidance, ceremony access, site works and accessibility before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Goa Gajah

pois.name: Tegenungan Waterfall
pois.notes: National and Bali tourism sources confirm Tegenungan Waterfall in Kemenuh, Sukawati, Gianyar, with a waterfall and natural-pool setting. The G4/Ubud node is an itinerary grouping, not an administrative-location claim, and the existence of a pool is not a swimming-safety promise. Recheck rainfall, flash-water risk, water level and current, wet rocks, stairs, swimming permission and safety, rescue coverage, crowding, ticket price and temporary restrictions before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Tegenungan Waterfall

pois.name: Kanto Lampo Waterfall
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms Kanto Lampo in Gianyar as a tiered waterfall with a natural pool and relatively short approach. Recheck rainfall, flash-water risk, current, trail and stair condition, water access, crowding, weather and fees before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Kanto Lampo Waterfall

pois.name: Tibumana Waterfall
pois.notes: National tourism guidance confirms Tibumana Waterfall as a forest-and-cliff nature destination with a short walking approach; Susut District lists it among the district's nature attractions in Bangli. The G4/Ubud node is an itinerary grouping, not an administrative-location claim. Recheck rainfall, water level and current, trail and stair conditions, swimming permission and safety, lifeguard coverage, access, fees and weather before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Tibumana Waterfall

pois.name: Jatiluwih Rice Terraces
pois.notes: Tabanan and national tourism sources confirm Jatiluwih in Penebel, Tabanan as a terraced-rice and Subak cultural landscape associated with Bali's UNESCO-listed cultural landscape. The G5/Bedugul node is an itinerary grouping, not an administrative-location claim. Recheck conservation and farm-access rules, designated paths, weather, harvest or planting activity, crowding, road and trail conditions, ticket price and current management notices before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: The Amazing Jatiluwih Rice Terraces

pois.name: Banyumala Twin Waterfall
pois.notes: Buleleng government tourism and location records confirm Banyumala Twin Waterfall in Wanagiri Village, Sukasada District, Buleleng, with a forest and downhill walking approach. Recheck road access, rain, trail and stair conditions, water level and current, swimming permission and safety, rescue or lifeguard coverage, opening and fees before travel.

pois.name: Munduk Waterfall / Red Coral Waterfall
pois.notes: Buleleng government sources confirm Munduk Waterfall, also described as Red Coral Waterfall, in Munduk Village, Banjar District, Buleleng, with a natural walking approach. It must not be merged with Melanting, Golden Valley or other waterfalls in the wider Munduk area. Recheck road and trail access, rainfall, flash-water risk, water level and current, wet surfaces, swimming permission and safety, rescue coverage, opening status and fees before travel.

sources.publisher: Buleleng Regency Personnel and Human Resources Development Agency
sources.title: Tourism promotion at Munduk Waterfall

pois.name: Gitgit Waterfall
pois.notes: Buleleng government sources confirm Gitgit Waterfall in Gitgit Village, Sukasada District, Buleleng, with a walking approach through a green highland setting. The G5/Munduk node is an itinerary grouping, not an administrative-location claim, and this POI must not be merged with Multi-tier, Campuhan, Colek Pamor or other Gitgit-area waterfalls. Recheck access, trail conditions, rain, water level and current, wet surfaces, swimming permission and safety, local guide rules, opening status and fees before travel.

pois.name: Lake Tamblingan
pois.notes: Buleleng tourism and environmental records confirm Lake Tamblingan on the northern slope of Mount Lesung in the Munduk/Banjar, Buleleng context and within the Buyan-Tamblingan nature-tourism area. The lake, surrounding forest, temples and trekking or traditional-canoe context are stable; recheck weather, wind, water level, boat availability and operator, conservation rules, trail and road access before travel.

pois.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Trailhead
pois.notes: Planning anchor; guide, weather, activity level and safety requirements must be confirmed.

pois.name: Mount Batur Jeep Sunrise Area
pois.notes: Supplier-dependent experience: do not recommend as execution-ready until the operator, exact route, driver or guide qualification, vehicle condition, insurance, pickup scope, weather policy and final price are confirmed.

pois.name: Batur Hot Springs Area
pois.notes: Planning anchor; choose a provider only after checking current access and hygiene details.

pois.name: Tukad Cepung Waterfall
pois.notes: Bangli government tourism records confirm Tukad Cepung Waterfall in Penida Kelod, Tembuku, Bangli and its rock-gorge setting with local community management and religious-use boundaries near the approach. Recheck rainfall, flash-water risk, water level and current, wet rocks, trail and stairs, access rules, crowding, fees, wading and swimming safety before travel.

sources.publisher: Bangli Regency Culture and Tourism Office
sources.title: Opening of Tukad Cepung Waterfall in Penida Kelod, Tembuku

pois.name: Pura Lempuyang Luhur
pois.notes: Karangasem and national tourism sources confirm the sacred Lempuyang temple complex in Karangasem and the mountain approach to Pura Lempuyang Luhur. The photographed gate at Penataran Agung and the summit temple are distinct places and must not be presented as one stop. Recheck the exact visited section, parking and shuttle rules, queue, opening areas, ticket or donation, dress and ceremony guidance, photography restrictions, weather, road and stair conditions and temporary closures before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Pura Lempuyang

pois.name: Tirta Gangga Water Palace
pois.notes: Government tourism guidance confirms Tirta Gangga as a former royal water garden in Karangasem with pools, fountains, sculpture and sacred water context. Recheck opening hours, fees, pool-access rules, ceremony access, maintenance and weather before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Tirta Gangga

pois.name: Taman Ujung Water Palace
pois.notes: Karangasem and national tourism sources confirm Taman Soekasada Ujung as a royal water-palace and garden complex in the Ujung/Tumbu area of Karangasem, with pools and mixed architectural context. Recheck opening hours, ticket price, maintenance or restoration work, weather, traffic, event or ceremony restrictions and temporary closures before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Hidden gems in Eastern Bali

pois.name: Amed Beach
pois.notes: National and Karangasem government tourism sources confirm Amed as an East Bali coastal area in Abang, Karangasem, with fishing-village, traditional salt-making, sunrise and marine activity contexts; Jemeluk and Lipah are specific bays within the wider area. Treat this as an area node, not one beach or one operator, and recheck weather, tide, currents, visibility, swimming and snorkelling safety, operator qualification, equipment, access, road conditions and fees before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Five activities at Amed Beach

pois.name: Tulamben Dive Area
pois.notes: Karangasem government sources confirm Tulamben Village in Kubu District as an East Bali marine and dive area associated with the USAT Liberty wreck. The G7/Amed node is an itinerary grouping: Tulamben is not Amed or Jemeluk, and this area node does not verify any dive operator or execution readiness. Recheck the exact site, traveller certification and medical suitability, operator and instructor qualifications, insurance, equipment, sea conditions, currents, visibility, weather, shore or boat arrangement, price and cancellation policy before any dive or snorkelling recommendation.

pois.name: Sidemen Valley
pois.notes: Karangasem government and national tourism sources confirm Sidemen as an eastern Bali district of villages, rice-field landscapes and cultural activity. Recheck weather, walking route, trail and road conditions, local guide or craft provider, ceremonies and traveller mobility needs before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Five rice fields to visit in Bali

pois.name: Virgin Beach / Pantai Perasi
pois.notes: Karangasem and national tourism sources identify Virgin Beach, also called Pantai Perasi or White Sand Beach, as an East Bali beach in the Perasi/Bugbug area of Karangasem. The stable beach identity does not promise calm water, swimming or snorkelling suitability. Recheck the exact entrance, road access, tide, currents, waves, weather, swimming and snorkelling conditions, rescue coverage, crowding, local fees and temporary restrictions before travel.

sources.title: Five destinations to visit in Karangasem

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: White sand beaches: Virgin Beach

pois.name: Pura Taman Ayun
pois.notes: UNESCO and national tourism sources confirm Pura Taman Ayun in Mengwi as a royal water temple and a component of Bali's World Heritage cultural landscape, with multi-tiered meru architecture. G1 is an itinerary grouping rather than a coastal-location claim. Recheck opening areas and hours, ticket price, dress guidance, ceremony access, photography rules, maintenance, weather and traffic before travel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia
sources.title: Pura Taman Ayun

pois.name: Pura Taman Saraswati / Ubud Water Palace
pois.notes: Indonesian tourism records identify Ubud Water Palace / Pura Taman Saraswati in Ubud. The stable identity and visible lotus-pond setting do not verify public access to worship areas or any performance. Recheck opening areas and hours, visitor permission, dress guidance, ceremony access, ticket or contribution, performance schedule, photography rules and temporary closures before travel.

pois.name: Sundays Beach Club
pois.notes: The official venue site confirms Sundays Beach Club in Ungasan on Bali's Bukit Peninsula, with clifftop arrival and inclinator access to the beachfront. This verifies the venue identity and setting, not admission, activity or sea-condition readiness. Recheck opening hours, pass price and inclusions, reservation availability, tide, weather, swimming and watersports conditions, lifeguard guidance, inclinator operation, driver parking and temporary events before travel.
